items.title: Jev Decision Models: Fast, Cheap AI Judgements
items.author: Advancing Analytics
items.summary:
Welcome to the first episode of AI Changed. Again?! Tori is back (briefly) from maternity leave to get caught up with Gavi on the AI shift she kept seeing everywhere: Jev, a new “decision model” that does not generate text, but makes fast, fixed-choice judgements. They unpack why Jev is being described as a large classification model, what “system one” thinking means in practice, and where these models shine, from scoring and evaluation to model routing for cheaper agentic workflows. Gavi also covers why accuracy claims are debated, how TypeSafe positions reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions, and how Databricks and Microsoft are already responding with their own decision APIs.

- TypeSafe AI: https://typesafe.ai
- Thinking, Fast and Slow (Daniel Kahneman): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thinking,_Fast_and_Slow
